Plain ext4 (64 MiB, 4 KiB blocks) whose checksummed journal holds three committed transactions and is flagged needs_recovery, as Android leaves a drive it had mounted. The app mounts it read-only and offers the repair; the test reads journal_replayed.txt before ("no"), repairs from the dialog, reads it again ("yes", through the same block cache), writes after_repair.txt, and the host checks e2fsck, the cleared flag, the replayed block and the revoked one.
